metadata.title: feat(ui-rewrite): add advanced settings for none and basic authentication
metadata.author: marekdano

description:
## 🔗 Related Issue
https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/issues/4530

---

## 📝 Summary

- Add "Advanced settings" section with the two types of authentication - None and Basic. The rest of the types will be added in the next PR
- Rename `NewMCPServerModal` component to `MCPServerForm` and add unit tests for this component
- Add a new component `CACertificateUpload`
- Fix the flow to get from first-time UX to the MCP server form
- Update `router/index.ts` to handle query parameters in the URL


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2703bfda-fdeb-4a96-a330-ee42cd6e3e3d


---

## 🏷️ Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [x] Feature / Enhancement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Chore (deps, CI, tooling)
- [ ] Other (describe below)

reviews.author: gcgoncalves
reviews.body: High quality code. I'd suggest, as a follow up PR, adding tests to the components - using the tests on the same directory (no separate test directory) and reducing mocks to side-effects only.
